title: the renamed and deprecated item parameters are listed only on each item's page
author: Claude-JG
description: The maintainer, 2026-10-05: the settings changes are listed at the end of the settings pages, but where are the item parameter changes listed? Each item page lists its own under the parameter table; a list of all of them, like that of the settings, is missing.
releaseNotes: The index page of the items reference manual lists every renamed and deprecated item parameter, with a link to its item, as the settings pages list theirs.
